rules.title: Missing or empty title
rules.description: The page has no <title> or it is empty. Titles are a primary source for title links in search results.

rules.title: Multiple title elements
rules.description: More than one <title> element exists; Google recommends exactly one per page.
rules.fix: Remove the extra <title> (often from duplicate head management).

rules.title: Title may be truncated in search results
rules.description: The title is long. There is no official length limit; Google truncates title links to fit device width. Listed only so you can check the important words come first.
rules.fix: Put the most important, distinguishing words first.

rules.title: Missing meta description
rules.description: No meta description. Google may use it for the snippet when it describes the page better than on-page text; it is not a ranking factor.
rules.fix: Add a unique meta description summarising the page.

rules.title: Multiple meta descriptions
rules.description: More than one meta description is declared; only one should be present.

rules.title: No H1 heading
rules.description: The page has no <h1>. Headings help users and search engines understand page structure; there is no requirement for exactly one H1.

rules.title: meta keywords tag present
rules.description: Google does not use the meta keywords tag for indexing or ranking. It has no effect; listed so it is not mistaken for an optimisation.
rules.fix: Optional: remove it to reduce noise (and avoid revealing keyword strategy).

sources.title: Google: Meta tags and attributes that Google supports

rules.title: Missing viewport meta tag
rules.description: No <meta name="viewport">. Pages without it render as desktop width on mobile; Google uses the mobile version for indexing.

sources.title: Google: Mobile site and mobile-first indexing best practices

rules.title: Missing Open Graph tags
rules.description: og:title / og:description / og:image are missing. Open Graph controls link previews on social and messaging platforms; it is not a search ranking signal.
rules.fix: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url).

rules.title: Images without alt attribute
rules.description: Images lack an alt attribute. Google uses alt text to understand images; it is also an accessibility requirement. Decorative images should use alt="".
rules.fix: Add descriptive alt text (or empty alt for decorative images).

sources.title: Google: Google Images SEO best practices

rules.title: Images without width/height
rules.description: Images without explicit dimensions can cause layout shifts (CLS) unless sized via CSS aspect-ratio.
rules.fix: Set width and height attributes (or CSS aspect-ratio).
rules.verify: Measure CLS in the field (CrUX) or lab (Lighthouse).
